name: Genus plc
research_rationale: FY26 filings still support accumulation, but no new trading disclosure since October and persistent FCF definition gaps keep research only partly aligned with the buy screen.

weekly_updates.summary:
Annual Report 2026 and AGM materials were published on 9 October; figures match September FY26 prelims, with no new trading disclosure.
The £60m buyback continues, with routine share admissions for incentive plans (including 14 October).
News flow is largely commentary on results and outlook; FY27 adjusted PBT is still guided in line with consensus.

Since the 18 October verdict, RNS flow is routine only: further buyback transactions, total voting rights at 31 October, and a holdings notification on 5 November.  
Google News adds no company-specific updates—only an LSE quote page and Simply Wall St analyst commentary.  
No material change to FY26 outlook or screen inputs in supplied sources.
